notes: Updater monitoring no longer treats transient updater/progress timeouts or restart disconnects as immediate failures; it keeps watching for the target version for up to three minutes.
Manual Check for Updates now shows a visible checking state and forces a fresh no-cache manifest request.
Dashboard Ammo Reserve now places quantity directly below caliber while retaining the two-column layout and progress visualization.
Fixed deletion of unused seeded manufacturers such as Blazer by persisting a hidden-seeded-manufacturer preference; normal reference protections remain intact.
Manufacturer logo controls now explicitly document WEBP support alongside PNG, JPG/JPEG, and GIF.
